story.iWant: to implement a Bronze IOManager for raw data persistence
story.soThat: raw links and HTML content are properly serialized and stored following Dagster patterns
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create BronzeIOManager class structure (AC: 1) - Create/update dagster_project/resources/io_managers.py file - Define BronzeIOManager class inheriting from Dagster IOManager base - Add class docstring with purpose and usage - Import required Dagster types (IOManager, OutputContext, InputContext) - Task 2: Implement JSON serialization for raw link lists (AC: 2, 5) - Implement _handle_output_link_list() method for link list serialization - Add full SHA256 hash generation for link list identifier - Include created_at timestamp (ISO 8601) in link list metadata - Write JSON to artifacts/bronze/raw_links/{hash}.json - Implement _load_input_link_list() method for deserialization - Handle file-not-found errors gracefully - Task 3: Implement HTML content storage (AC: 3, 4, 5) - Implement _handle_output_html() method for HTML content storage - Generate full SHA256 hash from URL - Create metadata dict with url, created_at, content_length, download_info - Write HTML content and metadata to artifacts/bronze/raw_html/{hash}.json - Implement _load_input_html() method to retrieve HTML and metadata - Handle missing files and corrupted JSON gracefully - Task 4: Implement IOManager handle_output and load_input dispatch (AC: 2, 3) - Implement handle_output() method with content type detection - Dispatch to appropriate handler based on output type (link list vs HTML) - Implement load_input() method with content type detection - Dispatch to appropriate loader based on expected input type - Add logging using structlog for all I/O operations - Task 5: Unit tests for BronzeIOManager (AC: 6) - Create test file: tests/test_bronze_io_manager.py - Test link list serialization/deserialization round-trip - Test HTML content storage with metadata - Test SHA256 hash generation consistency - Test created_at timestamp presence and format (ISO 8601) - Test error handling for missing files - Test metadata preservation across save/load cycle - Use pytest fixtures for temp directories (tmp_path) - Task 6: Integration test for file storage (AC: 7) - Create test file: tests/integration/test_bronze_io_manager.py - Test end-to-end link list storage and retrieval from bronze directory - Test end-to-end HTML storage and retrieval from bronze directory - Verify files created in correct bronze subdirectories - Verify full SHA256 hash used in filenames - Verify metadata completeness and correctness - Mark with @pytest.mark.integration

doc.title: Technical Specification - Epic 1: Medallion Architecture Migration
doc.snippet: BronzeIOManager class implements Dagster IOManager interface for bronze layer persistence. Handles JSON serialization of link lists and HTML content with full SHA256 hashes and created_at timestamps.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown - Story 1.2
doc.snippet: BronzeIOManager created in dagster_project/resources/io_managers.py. Handles serialization/deserialization of raw link lists and HTML content. Uses full SHA256 hash, includes created_at timestamp. Unit and integration tests required.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.section: FR001: Bronze Layer for Raw Data
doc.snippet: Bronze layer stores raw, immutable data enabling reprocessing without re-downloading. IOManager pattern ensures consistent data persistence with proper metadata and hashing conventions.

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Bronze layer stores raw, immutable data at artifacts/bronze/. File naming uses full SHA256 hash (64 chars). All artifacts include created_at timestamp (ISO 8601). Raw links stored in raw_links/, raw HTML in raw_html/.

doc.title: System Architecture
doc.snippet: Asset naming pattern: {layer}_{data_type}. File naming within directories: {full_sha256_hash}.{extension}. Hash input: URL for content-based artifacts, link list for raw_links. Full 64-character SHA256 hash eliminates collision risk.

doc.title: Data Models and Storage
doc.snippet: Current artifacts use SHA256[:16] truncated hashes. Medallion migration introduces full SHA256 hashes. Bronze directories: artifacts/bronze/raw_links/, artifacts/bronze/raw_html/. File existence checks for deduplication.

doc.title: Development Guide
doc.snippet: Testing framework: pytest (>=8.4.2) with markers for unit, integration, and contract tests. Test organization: tests/ directory with integration/ subdirectory. Use pytest fixtures (tmp_path), factory-boy for test data. Quality gates: make check runs format, lint, typecheck, tests.

doc.title: Story 1.1 - Define Bronze and Silver Layer Structure
doc.snippet: Bronze directories created: artifacts/bronze/raw_links/, artifacts/bronze/raw_html/. Integration test pattern established at tests/integration/test_medallion_structure.py. Full SHA256 hashing convention documented. All artifacts require created_at timestamp (ISO 8601).

package.name: dagster
package.context: Data orchestration - IOManager, OutputContext, InputContext, ConfigurableResource

constraints.constraint: IOManager must inherit from dagster.IOManager base class
All bronze artifacts MUST use full SHA256 hash (64 chars) for filenames, not truncated [:16]
All bronze artifacts MUST include created_at timestamp in ISO 8601 format
File storage paths: artifacts/bronze/raw_links/ for link lists, artifacts/bronze/raw_html/ for HTML
Asset naming convention: bronze_raw_links, bronze_raw_html (layer_datatype pattern)
Use Pydantic V2 only (no V1 compatibility)
Use structlog for logging, not print statements
Unit tests in tests/, integration tests in tests/integration/
Use pytest fixtures (tmp_path) for temporary directory testing
Code must pass make check (format, lint, typecheck, tests)

interface.name: Dagster IOManager Interface

tests.standards: Testing framework: pytest (>=8.4.2) with markers for unit, integration, and contract tests. Test organization: tests/ directory for unit tests, tests/integration/ for integration tests. Test patterns: Use pytest fixtures (tmp_path for temporary directories), factory-boy for test data generation. Quality gates: make check runs format, lint, typecheck, and tests. All tests must pass before story completion. Configuration: pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] defines test paths, markers, and options (-v --strict-markers). Integration tests marked with @pytest.mark.integration. Follow patterns from tests/integration/test_medallion_structure.py.
tests.locations: tests/ - Unit tests for BronzeIOManager tests/integration/ - Integration tests for file storage/retrieval tests/fixtures/ - Test fixtures and data (if needed)

ideas.idea: Test: test_bronze_io_manager_class_exists Approach: Import BronzeIOManager from dagster_project.resources.io_managers and verify it's a class inheriting from IOManager Pattern: Simple import and type check
Test: test_link_list_serialization_round_trip Approach: Create mock link list, serialize with BronzeIOManager, deserialize, verify equality Pattern: Use tmp_path fixture, test save/load cycle

Test: test_html_content_storage_with_metadata Approach: Create mock HTML content with metadata, save, load, verify content and metadata preserved Pattern: Use tmp_path fixture, assert metadata completeness

Test: test_sha256_hash_generation_consistency Approach: Generate hash for same input multiple times, verify deterministic output (64 chars) Pattern: Hash same URL/content multiple times, assert equality and length
Test: test_created_at_timestamp_format Approach: Save artifact, load, verify created_at field exists and is valid ISO 8601 format Pattern: Use datetime.fromisoformat() to parse and verify timestamp

Test: test_error_handling_missing_files Approach: Attempt to load non-existent file, verify graceful error handling (returns None or raises clear exception) Pattern: Mock missing file scenario, assert exception type and message

Test: test_integration_link_list_bronze_storage Approach: End-to-end test storing link list to actual bronze directory, verify file created with correct name and content Pattern: Use real bronze directory, @pytest.mark.integration, verify file existence and content

Test: test_integration_html_bronze_storage Approach: End-to-end test storing HTML to actual bronze directory, verify file created with full SHA256 hash filename Pattern: Use real bronze directory, @pytest.mark.integration, verify filename format and metadata
